bullets.text: Under supervision, implemented reusable Python modules for the review retrieval workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Under supervision, compared TF-IDF and pretrained sentence-embedding retrieval on held-out judged queries, examined recall at fixed cutoffs, and grouped retrieval errors by query type.
Under supervision, validated SQL joins with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized how product review group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
As an individual contribution to supervised research, implemented reusable Python workflow modules and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Under supervision, ranked public programming questions for provided queries using TF-IDF similarity in scikit-learn and checked retrieved documents against a small judged query set.
Under supervision, joined programming question document identifiers to metadata using SQL, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons, and documented missing-data handling.
As an individual contribution to supervised research, implemented reusable Python modules for the extraction workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.
Under supervision, compared rule-based and pretrained spaCy extraction on held-out annotated excerpts, checked span precision and recall, and analyzed errors by entity type.
Under supervision, joined programming question document identifiers to metadata using SQL, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons, and documented missing-data handling.
